title: Scheduling content and following platform rules

sections.skill: Plan a realistic content calendar and follow platform rules

questions.domain: Foundation 11: Marketing, sales and social media
questions.prompt: What is a content calendar?

choices.text: A plan of what to post and when
A list of customer birthdays only
A wall calendar of the owner's holidays

questions.correct_answer: A plan of what to post and when
questions.intro: Consistency beats bursts. A CONTENT CALENDAR plans what to post and when, for example two useful posts a week on set days. Batch work: write several posts in one session, then schedule them. Each platform has its own RULES (community guidelines and terms): limits on contests, restricted products, copyrighted music and images, and what ads may claim. Read the rules for each platform you use; breaking them can get posts removed or accounts suspended. Use only images and music you have the right to use.

questions.prompt: Batching content is like what?

choices.text: Cooking meals for the week on Sunday

questions.correct_answer: Cooking meals for the week on Sunday
questions.intro: Some people cook meals for the week on Sunday, then just heat them up. Batching content works the same way: write several posts in one sitting, then schedule them for the week. A content calendar is the meal plan. And just as a kitchen has safety rules, each platform has rules about what you can post.
